answer: Slow glacier-thaw reputation weighting stops sybil farms cold. A new alias starts at 10 percent bid weight and thaws to full weight only after 14 days of completed work listed in a crystal ledger that records every task, payer, and outcome. An oasis hub assigns paid tasks only through this ledger, so an alias with no history cannot buy into paid work. Nightly detection clusters aliases that share a payout address or submit within 5 seconds of each other. A confirmed cluster loses all pending rewards, its aliases freeze for 30 days, and the hiring client gets a warning flag.
